purpose: Separate the marginal association of a channel from its partial coefficient, so a table can say which one changed sign and which one simply is not identified.

finding.statement: The marginal association of M with the outcome reverses sign across panels (corr -0.690 on the submitted panel, 0.356 on the rebuilt one). The partial coefficient does not reverse (-0.520 then -0.105). Its 95% bootstrap interval includes zero, so the channel is not identified and neither sign is a finding.

nonlinearNote: Refitting the nonlinear bounded model on the submitted panel is degenerate: the outcome there is an exact affine rescaling of the C predictor, so the design matrix is rank-deficient and the coefficient path has no unique basin. That degeneracy is recorded rather than resolved, because it is the same defect the design gates report.
